newsitem.title: EGYPT: Spanish king arrives in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Spanish king arrives in Egypt.

text.p: Spanish King Juan Carlos arrived in Egypt on Monday for a three-day visit, his first state visit to the Arab country since 1977.
The king was met at the airport by Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak, airport sources said.

The Spanish government hopes the visit will be an opportunity to drum up business in Egypt for Spanish companies. The economic highlight of the visit will be a "business encounter" on February 19 at which Spanish and Egyptian business people will meet.
Speakers will include King Juan Carlos, Egyptian Public Enterprise Minister Atef Obeid, Economy Minister Nawal el-Tatawi and possibly Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri.
Spain is the 13th largest source of Egyptian imports.

King Juan Carlos, accompanied by his wife Queen Sophia and ministers, was due to make a private visit to the southern resort of Luxor on Thursday. He will have talks with President Hosni Mubarak on Tuesday.
